buttonClasses: a.button.primary (strong) / a.button.secondary (em, ink) / a.button.accent (strong+em, outlined), in p.button-wrapper
buttonization: formatted-only (a lone unformatted link in default content gets a.arrow-link)
eyebrows:
decorateEyebrows: short ALL-CAPS

directly before h1-h3 gets .eyebrow (main-wide, blocks included)
headingHighlights: global :is(h1,h2,h3) em = green, strong = cyan (styles.css) — sd-* blocks override inside their scope
sectionScaffold: main > .section { margin: var(--section-spacing) 0 }; main > .section > div { max-width: 1280px; padding: 0 var(--content-padding) }
foundationNote: User constraint: styles.css, fonts.css, scripts.js, head.html, header/footer are frozen; page tokens live in sd-* block scopes.
